    private static bool CanClaimUnstampedInitialState(TimelineProjectionState state)
        => state.Items is null && state.Error is null && !state.IsLoading && !state.RequiresScopedRequest
            && state.ActiveCorrelationId is null && state.LastResultCorrelationId is null;
    private void AnnounceProjectionState()
    {
        if (System.Threading.Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
        {
            return;
        }
        global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Infrastructure.Tenancy.TenantContextResult currentScope;
        try { currentScope = TenantContextAccessor.TryGetContext(RenderContext?.TenantId, "projection-render"); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException and not StackOverflowException and not System.Threading.ThreadAbortException and not AccessViolationException) { CancelOwnedAnnouncements(); return; }
        if (!currentScope.Succeeded || currentScope.Context is null || (RenderContext is not null && !string.Equals(currentScope.Context.UserId, RenderContext.UserId, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
        { CancelOwnedAnnouncements(); return; }

        if (!global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.ProjectionStateScopeOwnership.For(Dispatcher).IsCurrent(AnnouncementSurface, state.ScopeTenantId, state.ScopeUserId, currentScope.Context, null, CanClaimUnstampedInitialState(state))) { CancelOwnedAnnouncements(); return; }

        string group = "load:" + operation;
        if (_pendingLoadingGroup is { } prior && (!state.IsLoading || !string.Equals(prior, group, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
        { ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(prior); _pendingLoadingGroup = null; }
        if (state.Error is not null)
        { SetFailureGroup(group, "failure:" + (state.LastResultCorrelationId ?? operation)); Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, _activeFailureIdentity!, SafePageFailureCopy(state.Error), terminal: true); return; }

        { CancelResultAnnouncements(); SetFailureGroup(null); _pendingLoadingGroup = group; ClaimAnnouncementGroup(group); Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "loading", FcShellLocalizer["Am01Loading", "timelines"].Value); return; }
        bool filtered = false;
        SetFailureGroup(null);
        if (state.Items is null) { return; }
        if (state.Items.Count == 0)
        { if (state.LastResultOperatorInitiated || !_initialEmptyAnnounced) { SetEmptyResultAnnouncementGroup(group); _initialEmptyAnnounced = true; Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "empty:" + (state.LastResultCorrelationId ?? operation) + "|" + filtered, filtered ? FcShellLocalizer["Am27NoMatches", "timelines"].Value : FcShellLocalizer["Am02Empty", "timelines"].Value, terminal: true); RetireOtherResultAnnouncementGroups(group); } return; }
        if (state.LastResultOperatorInitiated)
        { SetLoadedResultAnnouncementGroup(group); Announcements.Announce(AnnouncementSurface, group, "data:" + (state.LastResultCorrelationId ?? operation) + "|" + state.Items.Count.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), FcShellLocalizer["Am03Loaded", "timelines"].Value); RetireOtherResultAnnouncementGroups(group); }
        else { RetireEmptyResultAnnouncements(); }
    }

    private string SafePageFailureCopy(string? error)
    {
        if (string.Equals(error, "SectionUpdatingText", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || string.Equals(error, "This section is being updated", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || string.Equals(error, "Cette section est en cours de mise à jour", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            || string.Equals(error, FcShellLocalizer["SectionUpdatingText"].Value, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        { return FcShellLocalizer["SectionUpdatingText"].Value; }
        return FcShellLocalizer["Am30QueryFailed"].Value;
    }

    private void CancelOwnedAnnouncements()
    {
        if (_pendingLoadingGroup is { } loading)
        {
            ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(loading);
            _pendingLoadingGroup = null;
        }
        SetFailureGroup(null);
        CancelResultAnnouncements();
    }

    private void CancelResultAnnouncements()
    {
        foreach (string result in _resultAnnouncementGroups) { ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(result); }
        _resultAnnouncementGroups.Clear();
        _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.Clear();
    }

    private void SetResultAnnouncementGroup(string group)
    {
        if (_resultAnnouncementGroups.Contains(group)) { return; }
        _resultAnnouncementGroups.Add(group);
        ClaimAnnouncementGroup(group);
    }

    private void SetEmptyResultAnnouncementGroup(string group)
    {
        SetResultAnnouncementGroup(group);
        _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.Add(group);
    }

    private void SetLoadedResultAnnouncementGroup(string group)
    {
        SetResultAnnouncementGroup(group);
        _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.Remove(group);
    }

    private void RetireEmptyResultAnnouncements()
    {
        foreach (string result in _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.ToArray())
        { ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(result); _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.Remove(result); _resultAnnouncementGroups.Remove(result); }
    }

    private void RetireOtherResultAnnouncementGroups(string current)
    {
        foreach (string prior in _resultAnnouncementGroups.Where(group => !string.Equals(group, current, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToArray())
        { ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(prior); _resultAnnouncementGroups.Remove(prior); _emptyResultAnnouncementGroups.Remove(prior); }
    }

    private void SetFailureGroup(string? next, string? identity = null)
    {
        if (_activeFailureGroup is { } prior && !string.Equals(prior, next, StringComparison.Ordinal)) { ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(prior); }
        if (next is not null) { ClaimAnnouncementGroup(next); }
        _activeFailureGroup = next;
        _activeFailureIdentity = identity;
    }

    private void ClaimAnnouncementGroup(string group)
    {
        if (!_announcementClaims.ContainsKey(group)) { _announcementClaims[group] = Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Announcements.SurfaceAnnouncementGroupOwnership.For(Announcements).Claim(AnnouncementSurface, group); }
    }
    private void ReleaseAnnouncementGroup(string group)
    {
        if (_announcementClaims.Remove(group, out var claim)) { claim.Dispose(); }
    }

    }

    private static string Truncate(string value, int maxLength)
        => maxLength <= 0 ? string.Empty : value.Length <= maxLength ? value : string.Concat(value.AsSpan(0, maxLength - 1), "\u2026");

    private static string HumanizeEnumLabel(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length + 10);

        for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = value[i];

            if (i == 0)
            {
                sb.Append(char.ToUpperInvariant(c));
                continue;
            }

            bool isUpper = c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z';
            bool prevIsUpper = value[i - 1] >= 'A' && value[i - 1] <= 'Z';
            bool prevIsLower = value[i - 1] >= 'a' && value[i - 1] <= 'z';
            bool prevIsDigit = value[i - 1] >= '0' && value[i - 1] <= '9';

            if (isUpper && prevIsLower)
            {
                sb.Append(' ');
                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else if (isUpper && prevIsUpper && i + 1 < value.Length)
            {
                char next = value[i + 1];
                bool nextIsLower = next >= 'a' && next <= 'z';
                if (nextIsLower && CountConsecutiveUppersBefore(value, i) + 1 >= 3)
                {
                    sb.Append(' ');
                }

                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else if (isUpper && prevIsDigit)
            {
                sb.Append(' ');
                sb.Append(c);
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append(c);
            }
        }

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static int CountConsecutiveUppersBefore(string value, int index)
    {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (value[i] >= 'A' && value[i] <= 'Z')
            {
                count++;
            }
            else
            {
                break;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }
